integrity: Mathematical proof and finite independent group-operation enumerations provided; no independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Necessary upper obstructions for nondecreasing comparison functions only; no universal optimal lower bound or sufficiency theorem. Assumptions require finite abelian Frobenius kernel, fixed-point-free cyclic complement with 3 dividing its order. A related published Engel-digraph classification covers the standalone Engel test structure.
title: Frobenius boundary obstructions for cubic-to-Engel probability comparison
